dataset: OurAirports open paved runways for the five planner airports
selection: closed=0 and surface ASP/CON/PEM; default longest published runway, then ID
heading: true initial bearing calculated from the supplied low-end to high-end coordinates
geometry: No runway endpoints are extrapolated. Runtime length is endpoint distance in the local frame; publishedLength retains the CSV value. Displaced thresholds and reported dimension discrepancies are preserved.
elevation: Published airport and runway endpoint elevations in metres above mean sea level. These reference values are not a terrain DEM or live collision samples.
